title: Shared Medical Technology
description: sharedmedtech.com Shared Medical Technology, Inc. US medical equipment rental and service company founded in 2004, HQ in Schenectady, NY — 7 offices (NY, MA, VA), ~40–50 staff, no external funding raised. Core business: urgent rental of patient monitors, ventilators, CPAP, ultrasound, portable X-ray, infusion pumps, and bariatric/XL beds and chairs — plus a niche no competitor claims to cover: State Regulatory Compliance certification for transporting XL/bariatric patients across 10+ states (vehicle inspections, certified safe transport). Real clients include Albany Medical Center, OrthoNY, Saratoga Surgery Center, Community Care Physicians, and Brooklyn Surgery Center. Self-developed logistics platform.
